title: The Alignment Gap: Beyond Next-Token Autocomplete

beats.text: Simply scaling language models to trillions of parameters does not fix their inherent tendency to generate toxic, biased trash.
beats.visual_focus: A massive, shimmering neural network cluster with erratic, glitching red outputs.

beats.text: The bottleneck is internet frequency; models treat the next likely token as ultimate truth, effectively echoing every bias found online.
beats.visual_focus: A heavy, monolithic data stream squeezing through a narrow pipe labeled 'Predictive Likelihood'.

beats.text: InstructGPT pivots the architecture by injecting human feedback loops, effectively re-weighting model outputs to favor user-defined, helpful instruction following.
beats.visual_focus: A feedback arrow looping back into the model, brightening its internal weight connections.
